name: The Chola fleet against Srivijaya
summary: The Chola emperor of south India sends a fleet across the Bay of Bengal to break the hold of Srivijaya on the straits. His Tanjore inscription lists the ports it sacked, from Kadaram (Kedah) to Sumatra: the furthest overseas campaign of any Indian state.

stops.note: The fleet leaves the Chola port on the Coromandel coast.
Nakkavaram, the naked islands, on the way east.
Kadaram, Srivijaya's port on the peninsula, is taken.
The Srivijayan capital is sacked and its king captured.
The inscription lists port after port along Sumatra's east coast.
Home to the new capital; the conquests are carved on the temple walls.
